title: TrapHub Auto Level Farm Boss Farm Auto Skill and More
features:
Auto Level Farm – Automatically grinds mobs and quests to level up your character.

Multi Quest – Accepts and completes multiple quests back-to-back in the same run.

Weapon Selection – Choose which owned weapon the farm uses to fight.

Farm Method – Choose how the bot engages targets while leveling.

Mob Offset – Adjust the distance kept from mobs while farming.

Tween Speed – Control how fast the character moves between farm targets.

Auto Buso Haki – Automatically trains and activates Busoshoku Haki.

Auto Observation Haki – Automatically trains and activates Observation Haki.

Auto Conqueror Haki – Automatically trains and activates Conqueror's Haki.

Auto Buy Haki – Automatically purchases new Haki levels when you can afford them.

Auto Sea 2 Quest – Automatically completes the quest chain to unlock Sea 2.

Auto Fruit Farm – Automatically collects Devil Fruits found around the map.

Auto Store Fruit – Automatically stores collected fruits into your Fruit Bag.

Fruits To Buy – Select which Devil Fruits to target in the shop.

Auto Fruit Shop – Automatically buys your selected fruits when they're available.

Auto Chest Farm – Automatically finds and opens chests around the map.

Auto Skill (Z / X / C / V) – Automatically casts your equipped combat skills during fights.

Teleport Island – Instantly travel to your selected island.

Boss Selection – Choose which boss the farm should target.

Auto Accept Quest – Automatically accepts the boss quest before farming.

Auto Farm Boss – Automatically fights and defeats the selected boss.

Auto Farm Sea Beast – Automatically detects and fights the Sea Beast world boss when it spawns.

Auto Stats – Automatically allocates stat points as you level up.

Points Per Stat – Set how many points to spend per stat allocation.

Webhook URL – Set your Discord webhook to receive script updates.

Auto Status Webhook – Sends periodic progress reports straight to your Discord webhook.

Anti-AFK – Prevents being disconnected for inactivity.
